purpose: Fourth expanded public source layer focused on antibiotic semisynthesis families, covalent-warhead installation, therapeutic oligonucleotide and conjugate boundaries, ionizable lipid delivery motifs, and medicinal metal-complex scaffolds.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate fermentation-core, reviewed-anchor, conjugation, or formulation policy
route-specific regioselectivity, stereoselectivity, protecting-group, and release-mechanism review
antimicrobial stewardship, covalent-inhibitor safety, oligonucleotide manufacturing, formulation, and metal-complex toxicology review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
antibiotic, covalent-warhead, oligonucleotide, LNP, and metal-complex entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Macrolide and ketolide antibiotic semisynthesis
families.strategic_principle: Treat erythromycin-like macrolactone cores as fermentation/semisynthesis anchors unless a reviewed fully synthetic platform is selected. Strategic work is sugar editing, ketolide C3 oxidation, macrolactone side-chain installation, and acid-stability/resistance-aware modification.

families.name: Glycopeptide, lipoglycopeptide, and cyclic lipopeptide antibiotics
families.strategic_principle: Use fermentation-derived glycopeptide or lipopeptide cores as reviewed anchors. Strategic disconnections are peptide macrocycle/crosslink logic, sugar/lipid tailoring, semisynthetic side-chain installation, and stewardship-gated analogue generation.

families.name: Oxazolidinone antibacterial scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Build or select the chiral oxazolidinone core with C5 stereochemistry tracked, then treat aryl/heteroaryl substitution and morpholine/side-chain edits as late antibacterial SAR under stewardship review.

families.name: Covalent inhibitor electrophilic warheads
families.strategic_principle: Separate reversible binding scaffold construction from electrophilic warhead installation. Warhead type, attachment vector, target residue, intrinsic reactivity, and off-target liability are required strategic metadata.

families.name: Peptide-oligonucleotide and lipid-oligonucleotide conjugates
families.strategic_principle: Separate oligonucleotide assembly, peptide/lipid module assembly, and post-synthetic conjugation or stepwise solid-phase synthesis. Linkage chemistry, terminal handle placement, purification, and delivery role are strategic metadata.

families.name: Antisense, RNAi, phosphorothioate, and 2-prime-modified oligonucleotide therapeutics
families.strategic_principle: Treat therapeutic oligonucleotides as sequence/backbone manufacturing objects: separate phosphoramidite monomer preparation, solid-phase chain assembly, backbone/sugar/base modification policy, and conjugation/delivery motifs.

families.name: Ionizable lipids and lipid-nanoparticle delivery motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate ionizable headgroup, linker, hydrophobic tails, PEG-lipid, helper lipid, and formulation context. Synthesis of a lipid component is not enough; pKa, biodegradability, cargo type, and formulation role must be explicit.

families.name: Medicinal metal complexes and coordination-scaffold drugs
families.strategic_principle: Treat metal center, oxidation state, leaving groups, chelating ligand set, geometry, and activation mechanism as route-defining. Organic ligand synthesis and metalation/complexation must remain separate reviewed stages.

anchors.name: Chiral oxazolidinone core and aryl side-chain precursor
Noncovalent binding scaffold plus electrophilic warhead
Oligonucleotide module, peptide/lipid module, and conjugation handle
Modified phosphoramidite monomers and solid-supported oligonucleotide backbone
Ionizable headgroup, biodegradable linker, lipid tails, and formulation-role anchor
Metal center, ligand set, oxidation state, and leaving-group coordination anchor

disconnections.name: Macrolide fermentation core plus semisynthetic sugar/side-chain editing

break_bonds: do not cleave the macrolactone core in first-pass semisynthesis
forward_logic: select an erythromycin-like fermentation core or reviewed macrolide core
plan sugar editing, acid-stability modification, or side-chain installation with site policy
track resistance and antibiotic-stewardship context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat common macrolide cores as semisynthesis anchors unless a reviewed total-synthesis platform is explicitly chosen.

evidence.citation: Macrolide platform article notes semisynthesis from erythromycin fermentation products and convergent alternatives.
Macrolide renaissance review summarizes second-generation semisynthetic macrolide derivatives.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when reviewed fermentation core and site-specific edit are explicit

disconnections.name: Ketolide C3 cladinose-to-keto and extended side-chain disconnection

break_bonds: C3 sugar-derived bond or oxidation-state link
forward_logic: map ketolide target to macrolide core with C3 sugar removal/oxidation-state policy
install extended side chain only after attachment vector is defined
separate ribosome-binding design metadata from chemical route feasibility
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not treat ketolide sugar removal as ordinary deprotection; it is a resistance-aware scaffold transformation.

evidence.citation: Macrolide mechanism review explains ketolide C3 keto substitution and extended side-chain importance.
Erythromycin-to-azithromycin review covers semisynthetic macrolide development and ketolide/macrolone context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit C3 ketolide and side-chain vector policy

break_bonds: late sugar, lipid, or side-chain modification bonds
do not cleave crosslinked peptide core unless total synthesis is explicitly selected
forward_logic: select vancomycin/teicoplanin/A40926-like source-supported core
plan glycosylation, lipidation, halogenation, or side-chain edit as semisynthesis/tailoring
track antimicrobial-stewardship and resistance context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use glycopeptide core as reviewed semisynthesis anchor; ordinary peptide disconnection is too weak.

evidence.citation: Semisynthetic glycopeptide antibiotic review covers 2014-2022 developments.
Glycopeptide modification review covers biological, chemical, and chemoenzymatic strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when reviewed core and tailoring site are explicit

disconnections.name: Cyclic lipopeptide acyl-tail and macrocycle semisynthesis policy

break_bonds: macrocyclization bond only under reviewed peptide/lipopeptide route
forward_logic: separate lipopeptide core, acyl tail, and macrocyclization/tailoring policy
for daptomycin-like cores, use fermentation/deacylation/reacylation or chemoenzymatic anchor when supported
track membrane activity and antimicrobial-stewardship context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat acyl-tail exchange and macrocycle closure as distinct strategic operations.

evidence.citation: Daptomycin minireview describes semisynthetic modifications, acyl-tail exchange, and chemoenzymatic synthesis.
Calcium-dependent lipopeptide review discusses structure, mechanism, and medicinal chemistry.

disconnections.name: Oxazolidinone chiral core and aryl side-chain disconnection

break_bonds: aryl-core bond or late amide/side-chain bond
forward_logic: set C5 stereochemistry by chiral amino alcohol or reviewed asymmetric route
build oxazolidinone core before late aryl/morpholine/SAR decoration
track antibacterial stewardship and mitochondrial/toxicity considerations
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: C5 stereochemistry is mandatory metadata; late aryl substitution alone is not core construction.

evidence.citation: Oxazolidinone antibiotics review covers chemical, biological, and analytical aspects including C5 stereochemistry.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for chiral core plus aryl side-chain strategy

disconnections.name: Oxazolidinone phosphate prodrug or late SAR substitution policy

forward_logic: solve oxazolidinone antibacterial core first
install phosphate/prodrug or late SAR appendage after core stereochemistry is fixed
do not treat prodrug masking as core route progress
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Classify phosphate/prodrug edits separately from core construction.

risks: late substitution may alter ribosome binding

evidence.citation: Oxazolidinone antibiotics review includes linezolid, tedizolid, tedizolid phosphate, and related derivatives.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate and only after core route exists

break_bonds: warhead attachment bond to noncovalent scaffold
forward_logic: build reversible binding scaffold first
install electrophilic warhead late at a reviewed attachment vector
track target residue, intrinsic reactivity, and off-target safety
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Warhead installation is compliance-gated; synthesis does not validate target selectivity.

evidence.citation: Targeted covalent drug review describes electrophilic warheads such as acrylamide and vinyl sulfonamide.
Covalent inhibitor review discusses electrophilic functional groups, sulfur(VI) motifs, strain-release motifs, and other warheads.

disconnections.name: Covalent-warhead reactivity tuning and residue-selectivity policy

break_bonds: reversible covalent linkage when product is a conjugate/probe
forward_logic: separate warhead choice from binding scaffold synthesis
compare acrylamide, chloroacetamide, sulfonyl fluoride, nitrile, epoxide, or reversible covalent motif by target residue and reactivity
keep probe/conjugate adducts distinct from isolable small-molecule targets
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as SAR/probe critique; do not promote route solely because an electrophile can be appended.

evidence.citation: Cysteine-warhead review compares nucleophilic substitution, Michael addition, and non-Michael addition warheads.
Covalent allosteric modulation review discusses electrophilic warheads including sulfonyl halides.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless residue/reactivity metadata is present

disconnections.name: Peptide-oligonucleotide stepwise synthesis versus postsynthetic conjugation split

forward_logic: choose stepwise solid-phase synthesis or postsynthetic conjugation
prepare oligonucleotide and peptide/lipid modules separately when compatibility demands
track handle placement, protecting groups, and purification strategy
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Separate module synthesis from conjugation; a single generic amide/click split is incomplete without solid-phase boundary metadata.

risks: delivery function not implied by synthesis

evidence.citation: Peptide-oligonucleotide conjugate review compares stepwise solid-phase synthesis and postsynthetic conjugation.
Oligonucleotide conjugate review discusses solid phase synthesis and solution conjugation boundaries.

disconnections.name: Lipid- or peptide-oligonucleotide delivery-module conjugation policy

break_bonds: delivery module to oligonucleotide linker bond
forward_logic: separate oligonucleotide sequence/backbone manufacture from delivery module synthesis
install delivery module through terminal handle or postsynthetic conjugation
track tissue targeting, cell uptake, and linker stability metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Delivery conjugation is not ordinary linker chemistry; target tissue and handle position matter.

evidence.citation: Lipid and peptide-oligonucleotide conjugate review covers therapeutic uses and conjugate assembly.
Peptide-oligonucleotide conjugate chemistry review emphasizes delivery and synthetic boundaries.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit delivery module and handle placement

disconnections.name: ASO/siRNA phosphorothioate and 2-prime modification policy

break_bonds: internucleotide phosphodiester/phosphorothioate linkages as manufacturing repeat units
forward_logic: treat target as sequence-defined solid-phase manufacturing object
select modified phosphoramidite monomers and sulfurization/backbone policy
track stereochemistry/diastereomer mixture and sequence position of modifications
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not convert each internucleotide bond into generic phosphate chemistry; keep sequence/backbone specification intact.

risks: biological activity depends on modification pattern

evidence.citation: Antisense and duplex RNA review discusses phosphorothioate and sugar modifications.
Antisense technology review summarizes backbone and 2-prime modifications.

disconnections.name: Oligonucleotide solid-phase boundary and terminal-conjugation split

forward_logic: separate oligonucleotide chain assembly from terminal linker or ligand conjugation
choose preloaded solid support, modified phosphoramidite, or postsynthetic handle strategy
track purification and salt/exchange form
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Terminal conjugation should be scored as manufacturing/linker boundary, not ordinary small-molecule coupling.

risks: low coupling yield on long sequences

evidence.citation: Oligonucleotide conjugate review discusses solid phase synthesis and terminal conjugation strategies.
Lipid and peptide oligonucleotide conjugate review covers postsynthetic conjugation approaches.

forward_logic: separate ionizable headgroup, linker, and hydrophobic tail modules
track pKa, biodegradability, branching, and cargo/formulation context
do not infer LNP performance from synthetic accessibility alone
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Score ionizable lipids with formulation metadata; head/tail synthesis alone is incomplete.

evidence.citation: mRNA LNP review describes ionizable lipids and other LNP building blocks.
siRNA LNP review discusses SAR-guided synthesis and screening of ionizable lipids.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for head/linker/tail split with pKa/formulation metadata

disconnections.name: LNP formulation component boundary policy

target_features: ionizable lipid plus helper lipid/cholesterol/PEG lipid
formulation-level target rather than single molecule

break_bonds: not a single molecule disconnection; decompose into formulation components
forward_logic: classify target as formulation or individual lipid component
separate ionizable lipid synthesis from helper lipid, PEG lipid, cholesterol/sitosterol, and cargo
track formulation ratios and organ-targeting role outside organic route synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not mark formulation component decomposition as solved stock; formulation metadata is required.

risks: formulation performance not implied by component synthesis

evidence.citation: RNA LNP review describes ionizable amino lipids, helper lipids, cholesterol, and PEG-lipid composition.
LNP design review discusses ionizable lipid pKa, headgroup, ester/linker, and tail structure effects.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low_to_moderate; formulation targets need non-route metadata

disconnections.name: Medicinal metal complex to ligand set plus metalation/coordination stage

break_bonds: metal-ligand coordination bonds treated as metalation stage
forward_logic: synthesize organic ligands separately from complexation
select metal identity, oxidation state, leaving groups, and geometry as reviewed coordination stage
track activation mechanism and toxicology
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Organic retrosynthesis is incomplete without metal center, geometry, and activation metadata.

evidence.citation: Bioinorganic anticancer drug review covers platinum, ruthenium, gallium, and other metal-based drugs.
Metallo-drug review discusses platinum drugs and other metal complexes in cancer therapy.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for ligand/metalation split with geometry metadata

disconnections.name: Pt(IV) prodrug axial ligand and activation policy

break_bonds: organic axial ligand linker bond when present
forward_logic: separate Pt(II)/Pt(IV) core, axial ligand synthesis, and prodrug activation logic
track reduction activation, ligand release, and coordination geometry
treat organic conjugate route separately from metal-complex assembly
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Pt(IV) prodrug scoring requires activation and axial-ligand policy, not only ligand synthesis.

evidence.citation: Metallo-drugs review covers platinum-based drugs and prodrug concepts.
Metal-based drug classification review includes radiometal and non-radiometal medicinal complexes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with activation and axial-ligand metadata

source_notes.summary: The v5 expansion promotes several backlog candidates: macrolide/ketolide semisynthesis, glycopeptide/lipopeptide antibiotics, oxazolidinones, covalent-warhead electrophiles, peptide/oligonucleotide conjugates, ASO/RNAi backbone manufacturing, ionizable lipid/LNP motifs, and medicinal metal complexes.

Antibiotic, covalent-warhead, oligonucleotide, LNP, and metal-complex records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires antimicrobial-stewardship, covalent-inhibitor safety, oligonucleotide manufacturing, formulation/delivery, or metal-complex toxicology review as applicable.
